en: Look! Are they all really leaving{SAUT}their theaters!?
W-We did it? Did I get through{SAUT}to everybody?

Humans aren't that weak.{OPTION}Stay out of our business.{OPTION}Anything is possible for us.
Yeah, that's right.{PAGE}No matter how many times we may fail,{SAUT}we can get back up and try again just as{SAUT}often.
Even if we fall, we get back on our feet.{SAUT}Take it from a human―that's how we{SAUT}work!
